search_intent: How Southeast Asian buyers can verify a Chinese EV battery warranty across different national approval systems, tropical conditions, charging standards, flood exposure and archipelago logistics
buyer_task: Verify, before import, whether a Chinese EV's battery warranty is a written, transferable, destination-claimable entitlement, separate from physical battery health, for a named SEA country.

CONNECTION_FAILED=DNS/reset; TIMEOUT=connect/SSL timeout; neither is DEAD.

sources.title: Malaysia Road Transport Department (JPJ)
sources.facts_supported: Vehicle Type Approval (VTA) is performed on every new model before registration is allowed, to control identity, dimensions, weight, construction and specifications under the Road Transport Act 1987; evaluated by National Committee for Type Approval and Homologation.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Singapore registration defines new vs used, caps imported used cars at 3 years, levies S$10,000, requires emission/noise compliance and B/L + cargo clearance permit - a national approval/registration gate for any warranty-eligible import.
Malaysia requires whole-vehicle Type Approval (VTA) of every new model before registration under the Road Transport Act 1987 - the national technical-admission gate.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: JPJ VTA page (newly added second country).
